records.name: Active recall from a blank page
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Recall before restudy; use a bounded topic already learned, reconstruct relationships, then correct against an authoritative source.
records.assessment_refinement: Score central propositions and relationship accuracy separately; repeat a cold recall after a delay and use a different question/prompt for transfer.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not reward page fullness, fluent guessing or unsupported additions. Retrieval is useful when the learner has first encountered and understood the content.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Confidence calibration
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Commit confidence before seeing feedback; compare confidence bands with actual correctness over many varied, low-stakes items.
records.assessment_refinement: Keep item-level predictions, outcomes and calibration summaries across at least several sets; inspect high-confidence errors first.
records.limitations_and_safety: A small sample cannot establish stable calibration. Do not use self-calibration as the sole basis for medical, legal, financial or safety decisions.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Explain a concept simply
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Require a correct mechanism, one apt example, one boundary condition and a novice-facing explanation; then test the listener’s paraphrase.
records.assessment_refinement: Assess factual fidelity, mechanism, boundary and listener reconstruction—not charm, accent or presentation polish.
records.limitations_and_safety: Simplification must not erase necessary conditions or turn analogy into causal proof.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Build a useful analogy
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Map at least three target/source relationships, test the mapping against a normal and edge case, and state where it fails.
records.assessment_refinement: A reviewer should identify whether the analogy predicts any false property; learner must restate the target accurately without the analogy.
records.limitations_and_safety: Analogy quality is domain-dependent; no evidence supports treating analogy generation itself as a universal mastery proxy.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Spot a hidden assumption
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Underline the conclusion, list premises, identify what must be true for the inference to work, then test a counterexample.
records.assessment_refinement: Use short arguments with answer rationales; score correct identification of the unstated premise and a plausible counterexample.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not label every unstated context detail a logical fallacy; assumptions can be reasonable when shared and supported.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Separate fact, inference, and opinion
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Annotate statements by epistemic status, then attach the evidence needed to upgrade an inference or verify a factual claim.
records.assessment_refinement: Use mixed examples from science, news and everyday claims; score classification plus justification and source traceability.
records.limitations_and_safety: A statement can combine fact and interpretation. Teach sentence-level decomposition rather than forcing one label on a whole paragraph.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Create a retrieval prompt
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Write prompts that require recall, explanation, comparison and application; answer without notes, then check and revise weak prompts.
records.assessment_refinement: Evaluate prompt quality by whether answers reveal understanding rather than cue recognition; include answer keys and misconception notes.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid ambiguous questions, trivia-only prompts and prompts whose answer is copied verbatim from a nearby sentence.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Error log analysis
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Classify each error (knowledge gap, misread, procedure, calculation, strategy, careless execution), identify cause and choose one next corrective action.
records.assessment_refinement: Use repeated tasks to see whether the same error class declines; compare error recurrence, not just total score.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not shame or over-record trivial slips. An error log is for diagnosis and action, not self-criticism.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Estimate before calculating
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: State a plausible range/order of magnitude and a reason before exact computation; compare result to estimate and explain discrepancies.
records.assessment_refinement: Use varied numeric contexts; score range plausibility, unit awareness and post-calculation reasonableness check.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not require a single exact estimate where multiple assumptions are valid. Avoid high-stakes estimates without proper measurement.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Chunk a procedure
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT FOR CORE LEARNING MECHANISM; INDIRECT FOR THIS EXACT MICRO-SKILL
records.practice_refinement: Identify meaningful stages, name the cue that starts each stage, and practise linking stages into the whole routine.
records.assessment_refinement: Assess both sequence accuracy and ability to recover after interruption; test with a changed example or context.
records.limitations_and_safety: Chunks must reflect the task’s actual structure, not arbitrary groups. Avoid teaching a memorised sequence that omits safety checks.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Basic two-hand object transfer
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Begin with a light, soft object at low speed; practise smooth transfer, symmetrical control and gaze management before varying direction or pace.
records.assessment_refinement: Record drops, unintended collisions and control across both directions; include a delayed no-demo trial.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not use heavy, sharp, breakable or hot objects. Stop if pain or numbness occurs.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Coin roll / finger manipulation
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use a common coin on a soft, clear surface; isolate finger transitions slowly, then link them. Demonstration plus short deliberate sets is preferable to speed-chasing.
records.assessment_refinement: Count clean controlled cycles, slips and resets over repeated trials; compare dominant/non-dominant hand only if comfortable.
records.limitations_and_safety: No throwing coins near eyes or mouths; avoid prolonged repetitive practice causing pain.
records.review_requirement: Use safe environment, appropriate equipment and stop-on-pain rules; coaching recommended for sport movement.

records.name: Simple pen spinning control
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Start with a capped, blunt pen; learn a single slow rotation with a stable grip before adding transitions. Use a padded area and controlled catches.
records.assessment_refinement: Assess controlled completion and safe catch consistency, not trick count or speed.
records.limitations_and_safety: No sharp pencils, pointed tools or spinning near faces/others. Stop for hand/wrist pain.
records.review_requirement: Use safe environment, appropriate equipment and stop-on-pain rules; coaching recommended for sport movement.

records.name: Knot tying: square knot
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Learn the crossing sequence with thick, contrasting, non-load-bearing cord; inspect symmetry and tails after each attempt.
records.assessment_refinement: Identify the knot correctly and reproduce it from memory on a different cord; check that it is not a granny knot.
records.limitations_and_safety: Not for climbing, rescue, securing loads, restraints or life-safety use; those require specialist instruction.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Knot tying: bowline
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use large soft practice rope; form the loop and tail path slowly while narrating each step, then verify the finished structure.
records.assessment_refinement: Reproduce and identify the knot under observation; assess correct structure, not whether it holds a person/load.
records.limitations_and_safety: Practice-only cord. Never use this protocol for climbing, lifting, rescue or securing people/animals.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Basic paper folding accuracy
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use square paper, align edges/corners before creasing, and compare landmarks after each fold. Begin with a small set of repeatable folds.
records.assessment_refinement: Measure alignment error qualitatively or with a simple grid; reproduce a fold sequence from a diagram after a delay.
records.limitations_and_safety: Use paper only; scissors/cutters are outside this protocol unless separately supervised.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Handwriting legibility under time
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Stabilise letter formation, spacing and baseline before gradually introducing a comfortable pace; use short passages with consistent difficulty.
records.assessment_refinement: Blind-reader legibility check plus error count; record speed only alongside legibility and comfort.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not reward painful grip, excessive pressure or speed that degrades readability; consider motor/vision/access needs.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Keyboard touch-typing home row
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Learn home-row mapping and finger return positions with low-speed accuracy practice; increase speed only after accuracy is stable.
records.assessment_refinement: Use repeated standardised passages; record accuracy, uncorrected errors and words/minute separately.
records.limitations_and_safety: Use neutral posture and breaks; do not force a rigid hand position that causes discomfort.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Mouse / trackpad precision
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Practise select, drag, double-click and target acquisition in a harmless sandbox; vary target size only after reliable control.
records.assessment_refinement: Record successful target acquisition, accidental actions and time; test on a new layout.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid tasks that delete, publish or purchase; use a practice page and undo/recovery where available.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Basic ball wall pass control
records.evidence_fit: ADJACENT MOTOR-LEARNING EVIDENCE; SKILL-SPECIFIC EFFICACY NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use a suitable ball, clear wall and safe surface; begin close with gentle passes, focus on contact and first touch, then vary distance.
records.assessment_refinement: Count passes received under control and passes returned to a marked target; test both feet at comfortable volume.
records.limitations_and_safety: Warm up, use safe footwear/space, avoid traffic/glass and stop for pain or dizziness; adapt intensity to age and ability.
records.review_requirement: Use safe environment, appropriate equipment and stop-on-pain rules; coaching recommended for sport movement.

records.name: Fold a T-shirt consistently
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Demonstrate a repeatable sequence, use garment seams as alignment cues and compare final shape; practise with one garment type before variation.
records.assessment_refinement: Assess alignment, compactness and whether the garment remains folded after handling; avoid arbitrary speed targets.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not equate one folding style with universal correctness; garment size/material changes difficulty.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Pack a small bag by checklist
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Define purpose, duration and constraints; list essentials, pack by category, then verify against the checklist and weight/space limits.
records.assessment_refinement: Scenario-based check: no critical omission, unnecessary duplication or unsafe load; learner explains trade-offs.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not store sensitive credentials or personal data in shared checklists; consider weather, accessibility and local context.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Sew on a button
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use a practice fabric and large button; demonstrate threading/anchoring and stitch tension before practice.
records.assessment_refinement: Check secure attachment, no fabric damage and comfortable spacing; learner can explain safe needle storage.
records.limitations_and_safety: Needle handling requires appropriate adult supervision for children and safe storage; no sewing on a person.
records.review_requirement: Adult supervision for needle/tool use; keep this protocol bounded to safe hand-tool practice.

records.name: Tie shoelaces securely
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use a stable seated or standing position; demonstrate one reliable method, then practise symmetrical loops and a snug but comfortable knot.
records.assessment_refinement: Walk briefly and check the knot stays tied without restricting circulation; assess independence on own footwear.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid excessively tight laces; adapt for mobility or dexterity needs.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Read a measuring tape
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Identify units, zero point, scale increments and measurement direction; measure a stable object twice and compare.
records.assessment_refinement: Record value with unit and repeatability; explain likely sources of measurement error.
records.limitations_and_safety: Watch the tape edge and spring recoil; avoid measuring near live machinery or unstable heights.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Use a spirit level
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Place on a stable surface, read bubble position, rotate the level 180 degrees to check consistency and compare orientation.
records.assessment_refinement: Assess whether learner can distinguish level from plumb where relevant and repeat the reading.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not climb or work at height to use a level; use safe stable surfaces.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Basic screwdriver selection
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Match bit type/size to screw head, inspect fit before turning, keep tool aligned and apply controlled hand force.
records.assessment_refinement: Show correct selection on several non-powered practice fasteners; no cam-out or damaged head.
records.limitations_and_safety: Hand tool only in this micro-skill; powered tools, electrical work and opening appliances are excluded.
records.review_requirement: Adult supervision for needle/tool use; keep this protocol bounded to safe hand-tool practice.

records.name: Organise a digital folder
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Choose a shallow, predictable hierarchy and descriptive filenames; move copies first, then verify before deleting duplicates.
records.assessment_refinement: Give a new user a task to locate a file; score findability, naming consistency and recoverability.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not expose private files or share cloud folders publicly; test with copies and backups.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Make a simple spreadsheet table
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Create labelled columns, one record per row, consistent data types and a clear header; test sorting/filtering on sample data.
records.assessment_refinement: Check that sort preserves row integrity, formulas reference intended cells and units are labelled.
records.limitations_and_safety: Use synthetic data; protect personal/financial information and do not trust unverified formulas.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Read a public transport route
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Identify origin/destination, route mode, transfer points and service notices; cross-check with current signage or official updates.
records.assessment_refinement: Learner explains the route, a fallback and how to verify arrival/stop; scenario includes a changed route.
records.limitations_and_safety: Maps can be stale; stay aware of surroundings, follow local signs and ask a trusted adult if uncertain.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Introduce yourself clearly
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use a context-appropriate name/role, one relevant detail and a natural close; practise short and longer versions.
records.assessment_refinement: Listener can accurately recall name and relevant detail; learner adapts to formal/informal context.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not disclose home address, school schedule, phone number or other sensitive details to strangers.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Ask a precise question
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: State the context, identify the unknown and ask one answerable question; add constraints only when needed.
records.assessment_refinement: A listener can answer without guessing what is being asked; score specificity and relevance.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid leading or coercive questions; respect privacy and allow the other person not to answer.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Active listening summary
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Listen without planning an interruption, paraphrase the main point and ask whether the summary is accurate.
records.assessment_refinement: Speaker confirms or corrects the paraphrase; assess fidelity rather than eye contact or nodding.
records.limitations_and_safety: Eye contact is culturally and neurologically variable; do not treat it as a required marker of listening.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Give specific feedback
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Describe an observed behaviour, its task impact and one actionable next step; ask whether the feedback is understood.
records.assessment_refinement: Recipient can state the behaviour and next action; feedback remains specific, respectful and evidence-based.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid identity judgements, humiliation and unsolicited feedback in sensitive contexts.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Disagree respectfully
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Restate the other position fairly, identify the precise point of disagreement, offer evidence/reasoning and invite correction.
records.assessment_refinement: A neutral observer confirms the opposing view was represented fairly and disagreement is focused on claims.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not use “steelman” to legitimise abusive or discriminatory treatment; safety and boundaries come first.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Speak for one minute without notes
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use a simple opening, two or three ordered points and a close; practise with a familiar low-stakes topic.
records.assessment_refinement: Assess coherence, factual accuracy, audibility and time range; record improvement without penalising accent.
records.limitations_and_safety: Stop if voice strain appears; do not force volume or disclose private experiences.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Summarise a long message
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Extract purpose, key facts, decisions, action owner and deadline; preserve uncertainty and distinguish requests from background.
records.assessment_refinement: Original sender or independent reader verifies no critical change in meaning or omitted action.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not forward confidential content or omit safety-critical caveats to achieve brevity.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Read aloud with punctuation
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Mark phrase boundaries, pause at sentence structure and maintain comfortable pace; rehearse with age-appropriate text.
records.assessment_refinement: Listener answers comprehension questions and identifies main points; score accuracy and intelligibility.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid forced accent imitation or excessive volume; accommodate speech/language differences.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Negotiate a simple agreement
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Identify interests, constraints and alternatives; propose options, clarify commitments and confirm a fair summary.
records.assessment_refinement: Both parties can restate agreed terms, responsibilities and exit conditions; no hidden pressure.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not practise coercion, deception or high-stakes financial/legal negotiation; seek trusted adult support when needed.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Write a concise professional message
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Put purpose/action in the opening, include essential context, use a respectful tone and proofread recipient/attachments.
records.assessment_refinement: Recipient can identify requested action and deadline; no missing context or accidental sensitive disclosure.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not share credentials, private data or screenshots containing personal information.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Use keyboard shortcuts safely
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Learn a small set of reversible navigation/editing shortcuts in a practice document; preview before actions that overwrite or close work.
records.assessment_refinement: Demonstrate each shortcut in a sandbox and explain undo/recovery; accuracy matters more than memorised count.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid destructive shortcuts on unsaved or production data; maintain backups.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Search with exact phrases
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use quoted phrases for exact strings, add distinctive terms and compare results; remove quotes if wording is uncertain.
records.assessment_refinement: Find a known passage or source among distractors and explain why query refinements helped.
records.limitations_and_safety: Search operators differ across engines; verify syntax in the engine’s help and do not treat rank as truth.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Evaluate a source quickly
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use lateral reading: identify who is behind it, seek independent coverage and trace claims to original evidence.
records.assessment_refinement: Given unfamiliar sources, document author/organisation, evidence, independent corroboration and limits.
records.limitations_and_safety: A quick check is triage, not full fact-checking; consequential claims need primary sources and deeper review.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Capture a reproducible bug report
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Record environment/version, exact steps, expected vs actual result, reproducibility and minimal safe evidence.
records.assessment_refinement: A second person reproduces the issue from the report without needing private credentials or hidden context.
records.limitations_and_safety: Redact tokens, passwords, personal data and private URLs; do not attach sensitive logs.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Use Git status and diff
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT OFFICIAL TECHNICAL/SECURITY GUIDANCE FOR THE TASK
records.practice_refinement: Inspect status before edits, use diff to understand changes, distinguish working tree from staging area and review before commit.
records.assessment_refinement: Learner accurately identifies changed/untracked/staged files and explains each diff hunk.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not run reset/clean/checkout or destructive commands as part of this skill; practice in a disposable repo.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Create a strong unique passphrase
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT OFFICIAL TECHNICAL/SECURITY GUIDANCE FOR THE TASK
records.practice_refinement: Use a password manager to generate/store unique credentials where possible; enable MFA and never reuse or share passwords.
records.assessment_refinement: Demonstrate account settings review and MFA setup on a non-critical practice account; do not reveal the secret to assessor.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not submit real passwords to quizzes or store them in ATHENA; follow current provider security guidance.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Recognise phishing indicators
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT OFFICIAL TECHNICAL/SECURITY GUIDANCE FOR THE TASK
records.practice_refinement: Pause on unexpected urgency, credential/payment requests, mismatched domains and suspicious attachments; verify via a known channel.
records.assessment_refinement: Classify simulated messages and explain the safe next action: do not click, report/delete and verify independently.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not open live suspicious links or attachments; use sanitised simulations and report through provider channels.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Back up a file and verify restore
records.evidence_fit: DIRECT OFFICIAL TECHNICAL/SECURITY GUIDANCE FOR THE TASK
records.practice_refinement: Make a separate backup copy, check destination and completeness, then restore to a new location and open/compare it.
records.assessment_refinement: A successful restore is the evidence; a backup icon or completed upload alone is not.
records.limitations_and_safety: Never overwrite the only original during practice; keep sensitive files encrypted and access-controlled.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Use a terminal safely
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Read command, target path and side effects before execution; prefer inspection commands and disposable folders.
records.assessment_refinement: Learner explains what a command will change and safely performs a reversible task; identifies risky flags.
records.limitations_and_safety: No blind copy-paste, privilege escalation or destructive commands; never execute unknown scripts from the internet.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Read a simple JSON object
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Identify braces, key/value pairs, strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays and nested objects; validate syntax with a parser.
records.assessment_refinement: Given a small object, accurately trace a value path and distinguish string from numeric/boolean values.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not paste secrets or personal data into online validators; use local/sample JSON.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Notice three levels of visual hierarchy
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Identify dominant, secondary and supporting elements using size, contrast, position, spacing and weight.
records.assessment_refinement: Ask viewers what they notice first/second/third; compare their scan order with intended hierarchy.
records.limitations_and_safety: Hierarchy is contextual and culturally influenced; no single layout formula is universal.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Frame a phone photograph
records.evidence_fit: INSTRUCTIONAL RESOURCE; NOT CONTROLLED LEARNING-EFFICACY EVIDENCE
records.practice_refinement: Choose a clear subject, check edges/background, use gridlines as an aid and take alternate viewpoints.
records.assessment_refinement: Compare a contact sheet; viewer identifies intended subject without explanation and frame avoids accidental distractions.
records.limitations_and_safety: Respect consent and privacy; do not photograph vulnerable people or private spaces without permission.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Lock focus and exposure on phone
records.evidence_fit: INSTRUCTIONAL RESOURCE; NOT CONTROLLED LEARNING-EFFICACY EVIDENCE
records.practice_refinement: Tap the intended subject, use focus/exposure lock if available, adjust exposure conservatively and recheck after recomposition.
records.assessment_refinement: Inspect sharpness and highlight/shadow detail at full size; repeat in a different lighting condition.
records.limitations_and_safety: Phone controls vary by model; avoid direct sun/laser aiming and do not assume lock behaviour is identical.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Use natural light direction
records.evidence_fit: INSTRUCTIONAL RESOURCE; NOT CONTROLLED LEARNING-EFFICACY EVIDENCE
records.practice_refinement: Observe light direction/quality, move subject or camera rather than forcing a harsh exposure, and compare front/side/back light.
records.assessment_refinement: Take matched frames with one lighting variable changed; explain shadow direction and subject visibility.
records.limitations_and_safety: Avoid looking directly at the sun; avoid unsafe positions near roads/heights to get a shot.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Sketch basic 3D forms
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Construct boxes, cylinders and spheres with simple contour/axis cues; observe proportions before shading detail.
records.assessment_refinement: Draw the same object from a new angle and assess volume/proportion rather than artistic style.
records.limitations_and_safety: No claim of universal drawing talent; allow accessible tools and avoid hand strain.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Identify dominant rhythm
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Listen to a short, age-appropriate excerpt and tap or count a stable pulse; distinguish beat from faster subdivisions.
records.assessment_refinement: Match a steady pulse across two excerpts and explain when tempo changes; use audio rather than visual cue.
records.limitations_and_safety: Keep volume safe; do not use copyrighted full tracks in redistributed teaching materials.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Match a pitch by ear
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use a comfortable reference tone, listen, hum gently and compare; practise short intervals without forcing range.
records.assessment_refinement: Use a tuner or instructor/reference tone to compare pitch direction and approximate match across trials.
records.limitations_and_safety: No shouting or repeated strained high/low notes; stop with pain/hoarseness and consult a qualified voice professional if persistent.
records.review_requirement: No forced range or breath-holding; voice professional review if symptoms persist.

records.name: Controlled breathing for speech
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Use comfortable, unforced breathing and phrase planning; speak on a natural exhalation without breath-holding or maximal inhalations.
records.assessment_refinement: Record a short explanation and assess whether phrases are comfortable and intelligible, not how long breath is held.
records.limitations_and_safety: Not a respiratory treatment or breath-hold exercise; stop if dizzy, breathless or uncomfortable.
records.review_requirement: No forced range or breath-holding; voice professional review if symptoms persist.

records.name: Observe a subject before drawing
records.evidence_fit: PRACTICE/INSTRUCTIONAL SUPPORT; EXACT MICRO-SKILL EFFECTIVENESS NOT ESTABLISHED
records.practice_refinement: Record shape, proportion, light/shadow and spatial relationships before adding interpretation or style.
records.assessment_refinement: Compare drawing against the observed reference; learner names three observed features and one uncertain inference.
records.limitations_and_safety: Respect privacy and consent; do not draw identifying details of people in sensitive settings without permission.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Spot color temperature shifts
records.evidence_fit: INSTRUCTIONAL RESOURCE; NOT CONTROLLED LEARNING-EFFICACY EVIDENCE
records.practice_refinement: Compare neutral references and warm/cool casts under different light sources; change one variable at a time.
records.assessment_refinement: Sort matched examples and justify the judgement using reference whites/greys and lighting context.
records.limitations_and_safety: Phone screens and auto white balance alter appearance; record display/light conditions and avoid absolute claims from one screen.
records.review_requirement: Subject review and learner usability testing still required.

records.name: Identify local emergency contact route
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Know the local emergency number and how to state location; keep a trusted adult/contact plan and verify official sources periodically.
records.assessment_refinement: Scenario test: learner chooses the correct route and can state location, callback number and immediate hazard.
records.limitations_and_safety: Bangladesh Police currently lists 999 as emergency service; local availability and routing can change. Do not rely on a stale offline note alone.
records.review_requirement: Verify local emergency route and local procedure with current official source; adult review before scheduling.

records.name: Check a scene for immediate hazards
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Stop at a safe distance; scan for traffic, fire/smoke, electricity, chemicals, structural danger and violence; do not enter unsafe scenes.
records.assessment_refinement: Use photo/scenario recognition and require the learner to identify when to stay back, warn others and call help.
records.limitations_and_safety: Recognition only. Never practise entering a dangerous scene, touching a casualty near live electricity or attempting rescue beyond training.
records.review_requirement: Verify local emergency route and local procedure with current official source; adult review before scheduling.

records.name: Communicate an emergency clearly
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Give exact location/landmarks, what happened, number/condition of people, hazards and callback details; answer dispatcher questions.
records.assessment_refinement: Role-play with fictional scenario and check that another person can locate the scene and understand the request.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not make prank calls; avoid sharing unnecessary personal details and follow dispatcher instructions.
records.review_requirement: Verify local emergency route and local procedure with current official source; adult review before scheduling.

records.name: Basic digital account recovery hygiene
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Use official account recovery pages, keep recovery methods current, protect email/phone access and avoid sharing one-time codes.
records.assessment_refinement: Scenario: identify official provider route and reject requests for passwords/OTP; demonstrate recovery settings without exposing secrets.
records.limitations_and_safety: Never help bypass someone else’s account; do not store recovery codes in public/shared files.
records.review_requirement: Verify local emergency route and local procedure with current official source; adult review before scheduling.

records.name: Recognise unsafe electrical conditions
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Recognise frayed cords, heat, buzzing, sparks, water near electrical equipment and damaged plugs; keep away and alert an adult/qualified person.
records.assessment_refinement: Photo-based classification: identify hazard, safe distance, isolation/escalation route; no hands-on repair test.
records.limitations_and_safety: Do not touch, unplug, open or repair suspect equipment; isolate power only if safe and by a competent adult/professional.
records.review_requirement: Qualified adult/safety professional review; learner outcome remains recognition and escalation only.

records.name: Read a basic product safety label
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Locate product identifier, signal word, pictograms, hazard statements, precautionary statements and first-aid/storage information.
records.assessment_refinement: Use clean sample labels; learner explains where to find the official safety data sheet and what not to infer.
records.limitations_and_safety: Never smell, taste, mix or handle a chemical to identify it; labels and local regulatory formats vary.
records.review_requirement: Verify local emergency route and local procedure with current official source; adult review before scheduling.

records.name: Use a fire extinguisher decision model
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Prioritise alarm, evacuation and calling fire service; understand that extinguisher use is for trained/eligible adults and only under strict conditions.
records.assessment_refinement: Scenario decision assessment: choose evacuate/call in any uncertain, spreading, smoky or exit-blocking case; no live-fire practice in this module.
records.limitations_and_safety: The USFA says young children should not use extinguishers. For a 13-year-old learner, this is recognition/evacuation literacy only.
records.review_requirement: Qualified adult/safety professional review; learner outcome remains recognition and escalation only.

records.name: Basic wound-care literacy
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Recognise that wound severity varies; know to summon an adult/medical help, protect from contamination and recognise urgent red flags.
records.assessment_refinement: Classify fictional scenarios by self-care information vs urgent/emergency escalation; assess source use, not treatment performance.
records.limitations_and_safety: Not medical training or diagnosis. Severe bleeding, embedded objects, deep wounds, loss of sensation or worsening infection need professional care.
records.review_requirement: Qualified adult/safety professional review; learner outcome remains recognition and escalation only.

records.name: CPR/AED competency pathway orientation
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Identify a recognised course that includes hands-on practice and skills assessment; track course provider, date and renewal guidance.
records.assessment_refinement: Pass only when learner can identify an appropriate provider/course and distinguish online theory from hands-on skills validation.
records.limitations_and_safety: This does not teach CPR/AED or certify competence. Never award practical CPR mastery from reading/video or an ATHENA quiz.
records.review_requirement: Qualified first-aid instructor review; hands-on provider assessment required. No practical competence claim allowed.

records.name: Choking-response competency pathway orientation
records.evidence_fit: AUTHORITATIVE SAFETY/COURSE GUIDANCE; NOT A VALIDATION OF THE ATHENA TEACHING PROTOCOL
records.practice_refinement: Find an age-appropriate recognised first-aid course with instructor-led practice; learn how to summon emergency help.
records.assessment_refinement: Assess course selection, provider legitimacy and completion evidence; practical technique is assessed only by qualified instructor.
records.limitations_and_safety: This does not teach choking manoeuvres. Do not practise on a person; never infer competence from a text simulation.
records.review_requirement: Qualified first-aid instructor review; hands-on provider assessment required. No practical competence claim allowed.
